scenario_text: A dilute collection of quantized oscillators shares a fixed amount of thermal energy at a given temperature, and the average energy per oscillator is measured. At high temperature the energy grows linearly with temperature, but at low temperature it becomes exponentially suppressed as excitations freeze out. Measurements span a wide temperature range at fixed excitation spacing.
